previous_statement: The objection conflates the symbol dot with uncompressed ambient multiplication. In the permitted def-ha-map, and hence in the corresponding compressed-corner data packaged by def-hcb-datum, dot denotes the typed compressed product: for A in S_{P,R} and B in S_{R,Q}, A dot B is Co_{P,Q}(AB), not the raw ambient product AB. Therefore the amplified-compression idempotence gives Co_{P,Q}(A dot B)=Co_{P,Q}^2(AB)=Co_{P,Q}(AB)=A dot B, so A dot B lies in Im(Co_{P,Q})=S_{P,Q}. Applying this to every Z_ij,X_j and using that Im(Co_{P,Q}) is a linear subspace yields V_i=sum_j Z_ij dot X_j in S_{P,Q}, hence V in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}. This argument uses only the definition of the typed compressed product and idempotence of Co; it neither asserts closure of raw ambient multiplication nor uses associativity.
new_statement: Under the exact allowed inputs, the required typing conclusion cannot be derived. The registered def-ha-map uses dot in its defining display but does not define A dot B as Co_{P,Q}(AB); def-hcb-datum merely packages corresponding compressed corners and does not assert S_{P,Q}=Im(Co_{P,Q}) or S_{P,R} dot S_{R,Q} subset S_{P,Q}; and lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities supplies only Co_{P,Q}^2=Co_{P,Q} and dagger compatibility. Hence the former equalities Co_{P,Q}(A dot B)=Co_{P,Q}^2(AB) and S_{P,Q}=Im(Co_{P,Q}) were unsupported. A valid proof of parent 1.3.1 requires an additional registered definition or external asserting the compressed-product formula together with the corner-range identification (or directly the corner-product typing). Because such an input is expressly not permitted here, this branch does not prove 1.3.1.
